title: hieracium saxifragum subsp. nitidum
intro: Hieracium saxifragum subsp. nitidum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium saxifragum subsp. nitidum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as a natural antihistamine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
